description: Read an owned project and its latest asynchronous takeoff progress, completion limitations and review link. Never advances or restarts a run, uses credits or changes billing. Poll this tool after run_takeoff returns a running result. lineCounts gives the lines delivered, how many are flagged for a second look, how many have no catalog item and how many are not yet confirmed: the same facts as the takeoff-finished email sent to the account's owner when a run finishes. This server answers requests only and does not push notifications.
name: get_takeoff_status
title: Read takeoff progress
